A one-off snapshot helper initially reused prior canary snapshot filenames during the first-batch check; corrected separate first-batch paths retain current full snapshots. Original canary apply/dry-run/size manifests and recorded successful check outcomes/hashes remain, but the earlier full before/after container JSON snapshots were overwritten. This affected generated audit evidence only, not production state.

The delayed timer next-time sample changed within its15–25minute activation window; the first short observer expired before the later sample. A full-window observer confirmed the natural successful run. No manual whole-batch start or timer timing change occurred.

The earlier 19:30 unit run was recorded before final helper provenance was established. The later final artifact verification above records the independently verified helper source, genuine run and timestamped preservation exception; no cleanup failure was hidden by a reset.

Final release validation passes 108 focused tests with 25 host-tool skips on the Mac. All 19 publisher capture regressions pass in an isolated checkout without private config. Ancestor/root symlinks, resolved containment, hard links, direct source writes and case-insensitive source aliases are rejected without changing outside bytes; the case-alias test skips on case-sensitive filesystems.
